About the Program

Mater Dei High School's Model United Nations Program is the school's premier academic program with over two decades of history. We are dedicated to shaping the next generation of diplomats, leaders, and global thinkers. Through rigorous research, spirited debate, and collaborative problem-solving, our delegates engage with the world's most pressing issues on a local and national stage.

Our incredible Program Director Mrs. Kitsinis and Assistant Program Director Mr. Deskovick have dedicated years of service to Mater Dei's MUN Program as veteran educators and MUN experts. Their leadership has brought immense success to Mater Dei's academic scene and has paved the way for future success. Our Executive Leaders for the 2026–2027 school year are President Margaret Kane and Director General Braddock Tripoli, who hope to elevate Mater Dei's already successful MUN program into an internationally acclaimed one.

This program has hosted the Monarch Invitational Middle School Conference annually since 2021, with the first-ever High School Test Committee held in 2026. The Monarch Invitational 2027 Conference is transitioning to a Super Conference scale, offering both MonarchMUN committees for high school students and CubMUN committees for middle and elementary school students. This event will take place on April 24, 2027 — more details can be found on the Conference page.

Our program is known across Southern California for taking elaborate international conference trips around the world. As a program, we have had the opportunity to explore Vienna, Rome, Dublin, Geneva, Prague, London, and many other destinations. For the 2026–2027 school year, we will be venturing through Madrid and Lisbon and competing in one of Spain's premier international MUN conferences. More information on trips can be found on the Travel page.

In recent years, Mater Dei has elevated its MUN program with the addition of our brand-new Varsity MUN Team — a selective, award-winning team known for bringing home top honors from prestigious conferences. The team is coached by Mr. Van Dyk, the History and Social Studies Department Chair and a UCLA and UPenn alumnus, with Captain Braddock Tripoli helping teammates excel and boosting team morale. For the 2026–2027 season, we will be competing at UCLA's BruinMUN 34, International THIMUN at The Hague, and many other local conferences.

We are proud to be one of Orange County's most competitive and passionate MUN programs. Mater Dei's Model United Nations Program lives by the "MUN is FUN" motto and will continue to pursue major successes in the years to come.
